name: Invoices view does not multiply linecount across its joins
note:
Fan-out coverage for a VIEW. A view introduces joins the underlying cube never performs, and if a join_path is not one-to-one the measure inflates silently - an inflated count still looks like a plausible count. Grouping by a dimension sourced from the JOINED cube and summing must reproduce the cube's own total exactly.

The grouping dimension is a STRING so validate.mjs picks the measure as the first numeric value per row. The reference SQL is reused verbatim from invoicefacts-linecount.json, so this case tests the view, not a fresh transcription of the business rule.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_invoice i JOIN c_invoiceline il ON il.c_invoice_id=i.c_invoice_id WHERE i.ad_client_id=1000026 AND i.dateinvoiced >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.dateinvoiced < DATE '2026-09-01'
